dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Judging by your expression, this must be your first time here, so welcome! I'm Acatl, chief of the Collective of Plenty.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: No need to feel on edge. We're not too concerned with formalities here — all that matters is courage, perseverance, and the strength of will never to back down in the ring.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Here at the Collective of Plenty, we show all valiant warriors and dear friends the respect they deserve. May your stay be a pleasant one.
